company.name: Zenitus Technologies K.K.
company.tradeName: ゼニタス・テクノロジーズ株式会社
company.description: Japan entity of the Zenitus Technologies group, established in Tokyo in March 2021 to serve Japanese customers. Provides bilingual consulting on outsourcing, management of offshore development, maintenance and testing of delivered applications, and technical training, backed by a bilingual engineering team.

mission: Make a difference by enabling Japanese and global businesses to run seamlessly through technology, staying customer-centric, simple and transparent.
vision: Digital transformation is inevitable for every business; bridge vision and reality with cutting-edge technology solutions delivered faster and more effectively.
